# schematron-rust

> Pure Rust ISO/IEC 19757-3 Schematron: rule-based XML validation, with no
> libxml2, no XSLT processor, no C toolchain, no FFI, and no `unsafe`. This
> repository is a monorepo holding the `schematron` crate and its companion
> website.

Schematron describes the *conditions* a document must satisfy — co-occurrence
rules, cross-references between distant parts of a document, value
relationships, cardinality that depends on content rather than position —
written as XPath expressions, layered on top of a grammar (DTD, XML Schema,
RELAX NG) rather than used instead of one. This crate contains its own XML
parser, its own XPath engine (a complete XPath 1.0 implementation plus a
documented XPath 2.0 subset), and its own validator; it interprets a schema
directly rather than transpiling it to XSLT.

`schematron/spec/` is normative for the crate's behavior: if code and spec
disagree, that is a defect in one of them. `spec/` at the repository root is
normative for the repository instead — governance, funding, publishing
policy — not XPath semantics.

## Start here

- [Repository map](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/index.md): routes to the right document rather than repeating what it says
- [Crate README](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/README.md): what Schematron is, install, library and CLI usage, feature list
- [Website](https://schematron-rust.github.io/): the same material as a browsable site, with a worked example and a conformance table
- [crates.io](https://crates.io/crates/schematron): the published package
- [docs.rs](https://docs.rs/schematron): generated API documentation

## Specification (normative for the crate)

- [spec/index.md](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/index.md): overview, design principles, reading order
- [spec/tutorial/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/tutorial/index.md): eighteen steps from one rule to a real schema
- [spec/data-model/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/data-model/index.md): every Schematron element and its Rust type
- [spec/validation/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/validation/index.md): the validation algorithm, exactly
- [spec/xpath/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/xpath/index.md): the XPath 1.0 engine — axes, functions, conversions
- [spec/xpath2/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/xpath2/index.md): the XPath 2.0 subset, and where it still behaves like 1.0
- [spec/xml/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/xml/index.md): the XML parser and its data model
- [spec/parsing/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/parsing/index.md): the five schema compilation passes
- [spec/svrl/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/svrl/index.md): the SVRL report format, read and written
- [spec/keys/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/keys/index.md): keys, and why a cross-reference check needs one
- [spec/linting/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/linting/index.md): catching schemas that silently do nothing
- [spec/api/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/api/index.md): the library surface
- [spec/cli/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/cli/index.md): every CLI option and exit code
- [spec/errors/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/errors/index.md): the error taxonomy — error versus finding
- [spec/conformance/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/conformance/index.md): limits and divergences, stated up front
- [spec/testing/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/testing/index.md): tests, fuzzing, benchmarks, lints
- [spec/roadmap/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/roadmap/index.md): shipped, next, and not planned
- [spec/agents-directory-name-is-lowercase/](https://github.com/schematron-rust/schematron-rust/blob/main/schematron/spec/agents-directory-name-is-lowercase/index.md): why the agent documentation directory is lowercase
